nodes.label: kt run CLI
nodes.desc: Entry point that resolves model config, checks environment, and launches kt-kernel serving or a SGLang command.

nodes.label: GGUF / SafeTensor Loader
nodes.desc: Loader family (GGUF, FP8/BF16/Compressed/GPTQ/MXFP4 safetensors) that translates checkpoint tensor names into kt-kernel expectations.

nodes.label: kt_kernel_ext bindings
nodes.desc: pybind11 module exposing CPU operator interfaces and advertising the CPU variant (amx, avx512, avx2) detected at runtime.

nodes.label: KTransformersOps CUDA
nodes.desc: Separate torch extension registering GPU helpers: custom GGUF dequant, GPTQ Marlin GEMM, and MoE top-k softmax.

nodes.label: Operator Interfaces
nodes.desc: Config structs plus MLA_Interface and MoE_Interface that every CPU backend implementation plugs into.

nodes.label: AMX_MOE_TP
nodes.desc: Tensor-parallel AMX expert kernel: loads INT4 expert tiles, runs gate/up and down GEMMs across NUMA partitions.

nodes.label: AVX2_MOE_BASE
nodes.desc: Fallback MoE base for AVX2-only x86 CPUs (including AMD) sharing the same operator contract as the AMX path.

nodes.label: AMX tile compute
nodes.desc: Low-level linear algebra: TMUL tile config, SwiGLU activation, and buffer helpers that feed the AMX dot-product units.

nodes.label: KVCache
nodes.desc: Paged KV cache manager with thread/batch/block resize and per-block importance tracking for sparse retrieval.

nodes.label: Sparse attention kernels
nodes.desc: Quest-style block attention: quantize queries, score block similarity, select top blocks, then run attention over the retrieved pages.

nodes.label: TaskQueue
nodes.desc: Lock-light queue that fans expert and attention jobs out to workers and lets callers sync on completion.

nodes.label: WorkerPool
nodes.desc: NUMA-aware thread pool with per-thread state, job distribution, and work stealing across sockets.
